analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The patch is two lines: the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and a clarification at line 52 that inline video input (data:video/mp4 or quicktime) may be constant or variable frame rate. The supplied units are base text from line 822 onward, so the changed lines are not visible in them. The surrounding base text covers the fan, stop, restart, logout, unenroll and report documentation. None of it is modified. This is a documentation-only change with no code, config, or control changes, so it creates no new attack surface and weakens no mitigation. The VFR note describes media handling that already exists in the provider. It may relate to T-050 (inline video plaintext in temp files) and T-007, but the diff does not show any change to the decode path, so no regression can be claimed. Whether the underlying code change that added VFR video support, in a separate PR, keeps the T-050 handling without temp files or bounds frame-count resources is outside the supplied evidence and needs review there. No threat-model assertions (T-041, T-053, TB-011) are contradicted or altered by this documentation change.
